components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and the result must hold 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The pet owner's postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be a 4-digit
            code that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region
            postcode ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Rejected with 400
            when out of range for the city's region. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Always returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the
            derived 'ageBand'. Always returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time directive acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares
            a household with an existing owner. When true, the create is allowed even
            though another owner has the same last name and postcode, and the owner is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate; otherwise such a request is rejected
            with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last
                name and postcode therefore share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b7c9d0e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners, formed
                as '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where a missing
                email or household id contributes an empty string. A create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2a1b7c9d0e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived from
                the owner's own fields: every owner starts at level 1, gains a
                level when an email address is present, and gains a further level
                when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0). The result
                is capped at 3; level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'F.G.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' evaluated against
                the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date was
                supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on the
                current business day, flagging a bulk-signup surge; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while holding a different
                telephone; false otherwise. Such an owner is still created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (same last name and postcode, different telephone). Absent
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true

## Summary

The task: expose `telephoneDisplay` — the stored E.164 `telephone` formatted for humans (`+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`) — while keeping `telephone` as raw E.164.

The codebase's established pattern for derived read-only owner fields (`displayName`, `membershipNumber`, `locality`, etc.) is a **getter on the domain model** that MapStruct auto-maps to the OpenAPI-generated DTO. I followed that pattern rather than inventing a new path.

Changes:

1. **`model/Telephone.java` (new)** — a small final utility, matching the existing `Luhn`/`Regions` helper idiom, that holds the single source of truth for E.164 country knowledge (country code → required national length) and the `forDisplay(e164)` formatter (country code, space, national digits grouped in threes).

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added `getTelephoneDisplay()`, which delegates to `Telephone.forDisplay(telephone)`. The setter-free getter means MapStruct maps it to the DTO automatically, and reads it without touching the raw `telephone`.

3. **`rest/validation/TelephoneNormalizer.java`** — refactored `requireValidNationalLength` to reuse `Telephone.countryCodeOf`/`nationalLength` and **deleted its private duplicate of the country-code table**. Now validation and display formatting share one table instead of copying it — no logic was moved into a catch-all, and the normalizer keeps only its parsing concerns.

4. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added the `telephoneDisplay` read-only string property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.

Result: the acceptance test `coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay` (input `0412 345 678` → `telephone` `+61412345678`, `telephoneDisplay` `+61 412 345 678`) passes, and the full suite is green.
